representative_tweets.text: ChatGPT can now do your groceries, book an Uber, get you that haircut appointment (hint hint), and much more. All without ever seeing your actual credentials and keeping it secure.

representative_tweets.author: @gdb
representative_tweets.text: chatgpt work for booking a haircut. chatgpt is increasingly becoming your personal AGI.

x_trends.description: AnthropicがLabor Day後（9月末〜10月上旬）に史上最大のIPOを目指すという報道がX上で注目を集めています。ユーザーは「SITUATION BREWING」といったコメントとともに、この潜在的なIPOがAI業界、特にスタートアップへの投資環境に与える影響について関心を示しています。

representative_tweets.author: @MTSlive
representative_tweets.text: SITUATION BREWING: Anthropic plans to go public after Labor Day, and is targeting late September or early October for what is shaping up to be the biggest IPO in history, per The Information.

representative_tweets.author: @Polymarket
representative_tweets.text: BREAKING: Anthropic reportedly plans to publicly unveil its IPO prospectus after Labor Day, with a potential listing in late September or early October.
